profile.headline: Software Developer  @ Epsilon | Computer Science
profile.summary:
Creating automation tools at Epsilon empowers teams to deliver scalable and efficient solutions. Built and maintained multiple Angular full stack applications for internal automation. Contributed to migrating critical endpoints from a legacy Laravel backend to a modern NestJS architecture, reducing project timelines significantly. Ensured smooth deployment through Docker Swarm, Jest for testing, and Bamboo CI/CD pipelines, while enhancing application reliability via Kibana monitoring.  

Graduated in Computer Science from UIUC, bringing expertise in Agile methodologies and cloud technologies like AWS. Prior experience includes developing high-impact recommenders at Amazon and optimizing CI/CD pipelines at AbbVie. Passionate about building solutions that streamline processes and improve outcomes for teams and end users alike.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Automated monitoring of legacy API endpoints to justify deprecation
* Wrote NestJS code to replicate existing functionality in Laravel PHP backend for critical applications
* Updated new endpoints to include unit and integration testing using Jest
* Dockerized NestJS microservices to be served in docker swarm
* Delivered new migrated endpoints through Bamboo CI/CD pipeline to ensure continuous integration and delivery
* Updated Angular frontend applications to access newly migrated NestJS backend
* Ensured consistency of application data through monitoring uptime and failures using Kibana watchers
* Improved estimated delivery date of complete migration by over 1 year
* Established best practices around monitoring microservice performance through writing Kibana watchers
* Built alerting service in Python, triggered by a cron job, to notify PagerDuty in case of critical application failure
* Created new Bamboo builds to deploy application to docker swarm with zero downtime
* Wrote docker compose files to create images for services in docker swarm with CI/CD
* Expanded existing automated quality assurance application to account for new data formats expected by product team
* Collaborated with product team members to develop webpages and UI/UX for internal use of automation tools.
* Expanded existing docker storage solution to account for new data sources

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
* Wrote full stack discounted items recommender using HTML, CSS, and Javascript
* Developed net new sorting functionality for Amazon recommenders shown to millions of users on Amazon Business
* Released new sorting recommender to Amazon users for testing with zero downtime
* Utilized Amazon recommending services to generate custom recommended item sets for each business customer
* Collaborated with team of 7 engineers to generate over $1 billion a year for Amazon
positions.insights: Agile Methodologies, Computer Science and +9 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
* Wrote new Github actions to replace existing Jenkins CI/CD pipeline
* Wrote Jenkins pipelines for CI/CD of existing internal applications
* Planned and executed migration from Jenkins CI/CD to Github actions
* Ensured new Github actions matched prior Jenkins functionality using A to B QA testing
* Generated unique data visualizations and weekly/monthly reports for internal DevOps team
* Created and organized original datasets within Power BI using GitHub Actions to track worker productivity
* Selected as only intern of 70 to receive Power BI paid service license to drive time savings
